7b21ed4314e6a1392f7606c60356c9e3f8b9b7d4.summary: ESET describes CloudMensis, a previously unknown macOS backdoor discovered in April 2022. It uses public cloud storage services (pCloud, Yandex Disk, Dropbox) for command and control and to exfiltrate documents, keystrokes and screen captures. Its first-stage downloader installs a second-stage spy agent as a system-wide daemon. The malware tries to bypass macOS TCC privacy protections, including by exploiting CVE-2020-9934. The report describes its distribution as very limited, suggesting a targeted operation, and says the initial compromise method is still unknown. Cloud storage metadata…
